chose: The cube is a case of a family, a prism of as many faces as the landing's projects, each face a member of the landing's one card type (a picture, then its words): its turn is drawn from the face count (cubeTurn), and its depth from the pane's width, so a project added or removed changes the shape, never the code. It has four faces today, a cube: Suspender Ledger's promo, Page Filter (the extension the owner uses most, by its still, which the gaps section shows too), the Android app's walk, and file_host's dashboard clip. A face's asset is typed as a clip or a still by its key, so a still on a face is no new kind. It rests on a face six seconds and turns in 1.2, and hovering holds it. A reader who prefers less motion sees no turn: the faces lie flat in a row, each with its words, and every clip gives way to its title card.
